subject: general
question: Which international organisation supports globalisation and free trade?
solution:
The correct answer is __**WTO**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **World Trade Organization (WTO)** is an international body that regulates and promotes global trade between nations.
 
• It was established on **1 January 1995**, replacing the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT).
 
• The WTO aims to ensure **free, fair, and predictable trade** by eliminating barriers like tariffs, quotas, and subsidies.
 
• It provides a platform for negotiating trade agreements, resolving trade disputes, and monitoring trade policies of member countries.
 
• As of 2023, the WTO has **164 member countries**, representing over 98% of global trade.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Globalization:** It refers to the process by which businesses and organizations develop international influence or operate on a global scale, often facilitated by free trade and investment.
 
• **Free Trade:** A policy where goods and services move across borders without government-imposed restrictions like tariffs, quotas, or subsidies.
 
• **Trade Dispute Resolution:** The WTO provides a mechanism for resolving trade conflicts between countries, ensuring that trade flows smoothly.
 
• **Most-Favored-Nation Principle:** A foundational WTO rule that ensures all members receive equal trade advantages, preventing discrimination.
 
• **Trade Agreements:** WTO facilitates negotiations on multilateral trade agreements to reduce trade barriers and enhance economic cooperation globally.
